get_subagent_run reuses get_background_run_detail (job_kind<>'workflow'), so a user's OWN non-subagent background run (e.g. sandbox_exec) is also fetchable via /api/subagent-runs/{id}. Owner-scoped, same DTO + perm the user already holds via /api/background/runs — no cross-user exposure or escalation. Deliberate reuse (DEC-6).
